how_to_discover: Agents can fetch this endpoint to discover protocol-specific MCP servers published under the Graph Advocate umbrella. Each entry includes the npm install command, supported chains, and example prompts. Route questions through POST / to Graph Advocate and it will recommend the right MCP server based on the question.
